explication: cliamp is a retro terminal music player for local media, streams, podcasts, radio, and many remote music services. The principal workflow begins with CLI startup and track or URL resolution, then presents and controls a queue in the terminal UI while the player decodes and outputs audio. Provider integrations supply browsable/searchable media, and the product also offers remote control, Lua plugins, and OS media-key integration. Main startup imports establish several runtime links; broader provider and radio workflows are documented in the README, so unsampled internals are represented at subsystem level.
